name: kind
meaning: entry kind (BonusKind), read with movsx (0x49ba76): 0 opens the image viewer, 2 a scene, 3 scroll text (BonusManager::Update's switch)

name: payload
meaning: the gallery name (PERSO, DECOR, STORY, COLOR, TEAM, INTRO) of a kind 0 entry, or in payload[0] the text id (BonusString) of a kind 3 entry; stride 12
